scientific_integrity: Proof supplied from explicit simplex-volume identities; finite exact checks and simulations are supplementary and not infinite proofs. Historical originality remains subject to independent scrutiny.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes iid uniform points on the circle and deterministic clockwise arcs; it classifies two-threshold covariance, not independence or higher-order association. Older general spacing theory may implicitly imply the formula and some phase results; a relevant 1984 circle-covering full text was inaccessible.
title: One-switch and zero-plateau law for multiscale circular coverage gaps
